351096ff6aa8: Ask: “What will the examiner tell you first in the car?” and “How does the test ask: may or must?” Two questions — two parts of the slides: commands (s2–s5, s8) and test language (s6–s7).
9bce507664e2: Reveal row by row. After each row the student shows with a hand what they do and says it in the first person: «Skręcam w prawo». This is exactly the reaction c1 expects.
3fe42b886c41: English uses one verb for both (“return it” / “don't return it”), so this is new for the learner. Show the pairs straight away to take away the fear.
79e1a7fd4bcd: The student reads the pair and immediately builds two commands: «Proszę zaparkować» / «Proszę tu nie parkować».
eeccd9ddc8ed: On the exam the key is to catch the first word: na / za / przed / przy. It tells you WHERE to carry out the command. Practise: you say only the beginning, the student points to the place on the map.
d0f0847f4cfc: Remind them: at some WORD centres the test can be taken in other languages, but the student has chosen Polish. These 6 constructions cover most question wordings.
b495bc299a03: In this situation, are you required to stop before the line? — YES / NO
e02d4ccf3a6c: What is the maximum speed you are allowed to drive in a built-up area during the day? A) 50 B) 60 C) 70
eb21e9037352: Should you give way to the pedestrian in this situation? — YES / NO
32b0dd95a2eb: The correct answer in the second example is A (50 km/h in a built-up area during the day). Point out that in the basic questions you get 20 s to read and 15 s to answer, so the key words (wolno, obowiązek) must be recognised instantly.
7d89624db734: The student builds 3 commands with the formula for their own city: real streets, real crossings.
31836f7a1a4e: «Proszę pojechać do centrum» is also possible, but in the exam you almost always hear «proszę jechać». Don't complicate things: memorise «jechać prosto» as a ready-made phrase.
c94e4a698b2e: Powrócić = wrócić (to come back). A change of direction is skręcić (to turn).
1f2c4e1b4be5: Przejście (dla pieszych) is a pedestrian crossing. A junction is a skrzyżowanie.
ec70573cf14f: «Powrócić w prawo» is the most dangerous mistake: the student may hear «wrócić» and think they are being asked to go back.
c408f7730c6f: Prawa = human rights. The document is prawo jazdy, in the singular.
6a66fd82956a: I was taking the exam, but didn't pass.
a69526617aba: Zdawać = to take an exam; zdać = to pass it.
3053a6f48bd3: «Zdawałem / zdałem» is a handy bridge to the next lessons: the student talks about their own attempts in the past.
